title: Behavioral Questions
intro: Behavioral interview questions for Ruby developers follow the same STAR structure as any engineering role, but the best answers are anchored in Ruby and Rails specifics — the N+1 you found in production and instrumented with Bullet, the Rails 6 to 7 upgrade that broke ActionMailer previews, the Sidekiq job you wrote before you understood idempotency, the service object refactor that made the model testable. Generic answers pass the bar; Ruby-specific answers with a clear reflection beat ('looking back, I'd have added a Pact contract test before decoupling that service') stand out. This page covers the most common behavioral topics in Rails engineering interviews with STAR-structured example answers and the reflection beat that separates rehearsed from self-aware.
